name: Summon_Spiderlings
display_fullname: Epic Stalker Mace Mastery Summon Spiderlings
display_help: Black Scorpion has granted you access to a small squadron of Arachnobot Spiderlings. Three Spiderlings that are one level less than you will show up when summoned. Your access to these Arachnobots is very limited. You can only summon them once every 15 minutes and they will leave after 4 minutes, or if you exit a zone or mission. You must be level 38 and have two other Mace Mastery Powers before selecting this power. Recharge: Extremely Long
